acts.setup: The site as Jonas left it: plumbline.lock.json written by init with rooms.html as a --source, the daily workflow file in the repository, the site signed with Jonas's throwaway key and its key record published. Played by up.
acts.raise-price: rooms.html: the double room goes from €89 to €95. The network still says €89.
acts.fix-network: larch_house.network.json: the double room is corrected to €95 (what Jonas would do). Needs raise-price first. Nothing is relocked or signed.
acts.cosmetic-edit: rooms.html: wording only (the introduction and the breakfast sentence are rewritten); every price, time and phone number the network states is still on the page.
acts.rooms-no-cors: Added at the coordinator's request, not in the journey file: rooms.html is served WITHOUT Access-Control-Allow-Origin (an ordinary host's default), so the Desk's reading of the rooms page from another origin can be tested. Every other file keeps the header.
acts.rooms-cors: The inverse of rooms-no-cors: rooms.html is served with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * again.
